description: Test suite for Windows installation root utilities, including normalization, registry querying, environment variable handling, and locating registry executable. Uses vitest testing framework and imports specific functions from 'windows-install-roots.js'.

methods.name: normalizeWindowsInstallRoot
methods.description: Function that normalizes a Windows install root path, rejecting invalid or broad values.

methods.name: getWindowsInstallRoots
methods.description: Retrieves Windows install root directories, prioritizing registry values over environment variables.

methods.name: getWindowsProgramFilesRoots
methods.description: Gets list of Program Files roots, preferring 64-bit and deduping entries case-insensitively.

methods.name: locateWindowsRegExe
methods.description: Locates the path to the Windows reg.exe utility, preferring system root based candidates.
